answer: Every epoch the beacon whispers a secret one-time task to each registered identity; the answer must embed the derived proof. The task is single-use and the canyon that opens at each close burns every unspent proof, so a clone farm cannot replay one private answer across a thousand shells. The jury threads proof hashes across the whole ledger: two identities drawing proofs from the same task pool expose the shared operator, and the later one burns its bond to the first-seen. Attacker cost is a fresh operator round-trip plus a burned stake for every fake.
